name: brandmd
summary: Command-line tool that turns any website's design system into a spec-valid DESIGN.md for AI coding agents.
description: Point npx brandmd at a public URL and it writes DESIGN.md in the official format (YAML token frontmatter plus prose sections) that passes the @google/design.md linter, with optional CSS custom properties, Tailwind v4 @theme, HTML brand guide and JSON outputs. Multi-page merge, dark-mode extraction and brandmd check / diff for CI drift detection are included.
contains: npx one-command CLI; default extraction runs locally with no API key
outputs: DESIGN.md, CSS custom properties, Tailwind v4 @theme, HTML brand guide, JSON
30 example DESIGN.md snapshots incl. Stripe, Linear, GitHub, Vercel
brandmd check drift detection and brandmd diff comparison for CI
optional vision pass for illustration, photography, voice and microcopy notes
companion brand-skills repo with 5 installable example skills
